headline: Huang's return sparks a huge tech rebound
context: Nvidia's board brought back Jensen Huang as chief executive, and last week's heavy AI selling turned into a broad rally.

winners.name: Nvidia
winners.why: Its board reinstated Jensen Huang as chief executive, less than two weeks after he resigned.

winners.name: Dell Technologies
winners.why: AI server makers rallied with Nvidia a day before Dell's quarterly results. Peers such as HPE also jumped.

winners.name: Micron Technology
winners.why: Its memory chips go into Nvidia's AI processors, and Huang's return eased fears of an AI slowdown.

losers.name: CrowdStrike
losers.why: Agreed to buy rival Zscaler in an all-stock deal worth about $43.9 billion, overshadowing record quarterly results.

losers.name: International Paper
losers.why: No company news. It fell even as other packaging makers rose with the wider market.

losers.name: Elevance Health
losers.why: No company news. Health insurers fell together on a day when most of the market rallied.

sector_note: Median move of stocks in each S&P 500 sector
chart_title: Tech led the rally, energy slipped

watch.title: Dell earnings
watch.text: A test of demand for AI servers after the tech sell-off.

question: Is Huang's return enough to end the AI sell-off?
